fieldData.full-article-text:
In the early stages of the Radix network, it will have a fixed number of validator node runners (100 validator nodes in the Olympia and Alexandria releases) and so they will have much more server-like requirements for processor and bandwidth to keep the network performant.

Click here for more information about running a validator node.

fieldData.name: What are the requirements for running a validator node once the mainnet is live?
